resources.string: Create named profiles instead of using the monitor\'s user numbers. Choose who each new measurement belongs to. At least one profile is required while this feature is enabled.
Choose the user who should receive this user\'s saved measurements. Removing a user does not delete measurements or change copies already sent elsewhere.
Enter a non-empty name of no more than 100 characters.
Could not save this change. Try again.
Choose a user for this measurement. Pending measurements are shown from oldest to newest. You can return later without losing them.
New measurements that need a user before they can be filed or exported.
%1$d measurements are saved and waiting for you to choose a user. Tap to assign them.
Choose your own virtual user before enabling Health Connect export. Only assigned measurements for that user will be exported. Unassigned measurements remain private until you choose who took them.
Enabling export includes eligible saved readings assigned to the selected user. Measurements waiting for a user are not exported.
Health Connect represents one person. Choose only your own user. Switching between monitor-bank and virtual-user modes requires selecting your user and enabling export again.
Measurements waiting for a user stay in a temporary private queue, including in passthrough mode. They are not added to history, Health Connect or HTTP uploads until you assign them.
Existing history is kept. Previously saved readings without a virtual user are shown as unassigned. Turning this feature off keeps pending measurements and your named profiles.
